```yaml
name: Skill Check Token Usage Dashboard

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  collect-metrics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
      
      - name: Run MetricsCollector
        run: dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/MetricsCollector.csproj
      
      - name: Aggregate token data
        run: |
          pwsh generate-token-data.ps1
          mv data/token-usage.json ${{ github.workspace }}/data/
      
      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add data/token-usage.json
          git commit -m "Update token usage data"
          git push origin main

  build-dashboard:
    needs: collect-metrics
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Build dashboard
        run: npm run build
      
      - name: Deploy dashboard
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./dist
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a daily job to collect token usage metrics using the `MetricsCollector`, aggregate them using PowerShell script, and then build and deploy a token usage dashboard using a static site generator. The dashboard is deployed to the repository's GitHub Pages.
